meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: Claude 仍是主调度者,但可以把任务交给宿主上本地运行的 Ollama 模型:它能列出已安装的模型,并让指定模型生成回答;开启管理工具后,还能下载、删除、查看模型和查看内存中已加载的模型。
howto.when: 当你要求用本地 Ollama 模型生成回答或列出已装模型时触发;若已开启管理工具,让代理管理模型库(下载、删除、查看等)时也会接管。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 代理会先列出模型,再让某个模型生成回答

say.text: 现在内存里加载了哪些 ollama 模型?

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload work to local Ollama models on the host: it can list installed models and have a chosen model generate a response. With admin tools enabled it can also pull, delete, show models and list running ones.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask a local Ollama model to answer or list installed models; with admin tools enabled it also takes over when you ask the agent to manage the model library (pull, delete, show, list running).

say_en.text: use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models, then generates with one

say_en.text: which ollama models are loaded in memory?
